podcast.title: Prominent Goth Band (1983-1984)
podcast.body: Listed as one of the new bands that emerged during the pivotal 1983-1984 era of goth music. "Flesh for Lulu"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: John Hughes Film Exposure (1980s)
podcast.body: Flesh for Lulu's music was heavily mined for the soundtracks of John Hughes' 1980s films. These carefully curated soundtracks played a significant role in exposing numerous North American audiences to various alternative rock acts, particularly British performers. "So many people learned of bands like The Specials and Spandovalet and Billy Idle and General Public and Wang Chung and Yellow and New Order and the Psychedelic Furs and the Smiths and Echo and the Bunyman, Susanne Vagan in excess the Jesus and Mary chain, Flesh for Luluo and so many others from those soundtrack albums."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Prominent Goth Band (1983-1984)
xref.body: Gene Loves Jezebel was mentioned as one of the new bands contributing to the significant expansion of the goth scene during the 1983-1984 period. "There was Jean Love's Jezebel, Flesh for Lulu"
